brief:
A prominent US rabbi attributed the decline of what he called the "Jewish Golden Age" to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's "right wing messianism," Middle East Eye reported. Rabbi Ammiel Hirsch said anti-Zionism had become normalized in American public life, according to the outlet's account of his remarks.

Hirsch urged Jewish leaders to reassess their positions in light of shifting public sentiment, though the full scope of his argument was not detailed in the summary.

title: US rabbi faults Netanyahu's ideology for ending Jewish Golden Age
